apoli.config.title: Apoli Settings
apoli.config.hud_auto_stack.tooltip: Stack the power bars on top of whatever the HUD already draws above the hotbar, including rows added by other mods. Turn this off to pin them to the vanilla position and place them by hand with the offsets.
apoli.config.hud_offset_x.tooltip: Nudges the power bars sideways from wherever they would otherwise sit.
apoli.config.hud_offset_y.tooltip: Nudges the power bars down (positive) or up (negative) from wherever they would otherwise sit.
